alex chen: Quick check — DeepDyne pilot cutover is scheduled for Wed 3/27. Need final signoff on integrations and success criteria. @maya can you confirm the connection test and sample dataset upload? Also who owns the rollback plan? cc @liam @rajiv

maya patel: I'll run the connection test tomorrow and upload sample data to s3://redwood-pocs/deepdyne/testdata. ETA EOD Tue. Rollback plan — not owned by infra yet, can take if needed.

liam jensen: I can own rollback (runbook + infra switches). Will draft runbook by Tue noon and add the canary policy to the Redwood Console route.

rajiv kumar: Integration deliverables status: SDK connector done (PR #328), docs draft in Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/xyz. Waiting on code review from @samantha.

samantha rao: Reviewing PR #328 now, left one minor comment on retry/backoff. If that's addressed I'll approve before EOD.

deploy-bot: CI: build deepdyne-pilot/583 — ✅ passed, integration tests: 1 flaky (test_embedding_timeout). Details: https://ci.redwood/internal/583

alex chen: Thanks — action items recap: 1) maya upload + conn test (EOD Tue), 2) liam runbook Tue noon, 3) samantha approve PR EOD. Success criteria to confirm with SEs: a) end-to-end p50 < 400ms, b) sample dataset inference covers <= 10k tokens, c) no data exfil/privacy flags. Keep it tight :rocket:

maya patel: Noted, I'll post test logs here when done (will include curl + sample payload).

liam jensen: Runbook draft path: ```/doc/runbooks/deepdyne-cutover.md``` — will open PR and paste link once ready.

samantha rao: Approved after minor fix pushed.

alex chen: Perfect. I'll update the sales playbook and notify the customer. Thanks team :raised_hands:
